title: Cross-connections of the normed algebra of finite rank bounded operators on a Hilbert space
summary: In this article we examine the cross-connections of the normal category of finite dimensional subspaces of a Hilbert space and it's dual space. Further, we describe the cross-connection semigroup of cones, which is a normed algebra isomrphic to the normed algebra of finite rank bounded operators on a Hilbert space. We also characterize compact operators and their spectrum by the normal cones in the normal category of proper subspaces of a Hilbert space.
